package.name: irstea-weather-dataset-of-the-montoldre-experimental-farm
package.author: catherine roussey
package.notes:
We have published RDF data about one of the meteorological stations that Irstea owns in its experimental farm at Montoldre. Our objective is to revisit previous work done by other researchers on the publication of meteorological
Linked Data, and provide some recommendations and best practices based on our experience. We use a networks of ontologies organised around the Semantic Sensor Network ontology of the W3C. We published the measurements about temperature, precipitation, wind and solar radiation.  The measurements start from August 2018 and are updated daily.

if you need more information have a look to the page
http://ontology.irstea.fr/pmwiki.php/Site/WeatherSOSA
the url of the sparql endpoint is described on this web page and some documentations are provided.

package.name: bsv
package.author: catherine roussey
package.notes:
Plant Health Bulletins (PHB) are named Bulletins de Santé du Végétal (BSV) in french. This dataset is an open archive of PHB published after 2009.

The dataset is one result of the french project untitled VESPA (Value and optimization of epidemiosurveillance devices in a sustainable crop protection strategy) leading by INRA.

A PHB is an information document, both technical and regulatory in nature, written under the responsibility of a regional epidemiological surveillance committee. A PHB gathers information about the health status of crops. It first presents pest risk analysis, and it is also used to disseminate regulatory information (mandatory control order, national notes, regulation evolution, etc.) and non-regulatory information (description of pest biology or prophylactic methods, such as management of intercropping, tillage, choice of cultivars, etc.).

To access PHB a french thesaurus has been developed called FrenchCropUsage. This is a thesaurus of types of crops, organized according to their destination (direct human food, animal feed, food industry, etc) and the type of culture system (field crop, market gardening, etc.). This thesaurus represents the French point of view. 

More information are available at http://ontology.irstea.fr/pmwiki.php/Site/BSV
package.title: French Plant Health Bulletins
